rulings.ruling: Ruling: defect, fixed (BUG-0076). Lines 1 to 9 are the worksheet (i1040gi p. 99): line 1 capped at $2,500, lines 2 to 4 from Form 1040 line 9 less Schedule 1 lines 11 to 20, 23 and 25 (the ones out of scope refused by scope.schedule1), $85,000/$170,000 and $15,000/$30,000, ratio to three places capped at 1.000 (amb.2025.sli_ratio_places), and the Pub. 970 exception refused (sa.excluded_income). The gate differs: i1040gi p. 98 requires 'You, or your spouse if filing jointly, aren't claimed as a dependent on someone else's ... 2025 tax return', and sli.claimed asks only 'Are you claimed as a dependent on someone else's (such as your parent's) 2025 tax return?'. Case: joint return, $2,000 of interest, the spouse claimed by a parent (sa.dependent yes, sli.claimed no): Schedule 1 line 21 is $1,010 and Form 1040 lines 10 and 11a carry it, unrefused; line 12e onward refuses on sa.dependent. sli.claimed should ask 'Are you, or your spouse if filing jointly, claimed as a dependent ...'. sli.claimed now asks 'Are you, or your spouse if filing jointly, claimed as a dependent ...', as i1040gi p. 98.
